What makes this tour special

We will start on Avenue Road, followed by pit stops at jewellery polishing shops, stroll through a 150 year old heritage structure and experience a different kind of nightlife comes alive here with the street food vendors, small businesses and shops. We will end the walk on Avenue Road at Rice Memorial. This is the only walk that brings you the best of a local market, history, and street food in one. Walk with us through the lanes of the ever-bustling Chickpete and understand the rich cultural and heritage history of the space.

Chickpete is popularly known as a bustling market. But did you know, it doubles up as a food street at night with carts serving everything from piping hot jalebis to pan-made badam milk? Explore the evening vibe of the oldest neighbourhood of the city. While the business hubs thrive during the day, an insane food scene erupts at night, right in the heart of Bengaluru’s most thriving, busiest market. Savour Bangalore’s best half pudi dosa, a secret vada pav joint straight from Maharashtra, patli jalebi on the cart, and the 365 day thandai service from the town’s best juice maker. This is the only walk that brings you the best of a marketplace, history, and street food in one.
